content.about: Haiti occupies the western third of Hispaniola. In 1804 it became the first country founded after a successful slave revolt. Its art and music are vibrant. Kreyòl is spoken alongside French.

standout.text: The Citadelle Laferrière is the largest fortress in the Americas.

didYouKnow: Haiti was the first Black-led republic.
Its art is famous for colour.
Kreyòl is spoken by nearly all.
